definitions.explanation: A doubt about whether something is correct, proper or legitimate, especially about a decision, an interpretation or a procedure. Formal; used in official, legal, academic and business writing.

examples.japanese: {疑義|ぎぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{呈|てい}する→呈する：12003_teisuru⟧。
⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{判定|はんてい}→判定：09767_hantei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{疑義|ぎぎ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are doubts about that ruling.

examples.japanese: ⟦{契約|けいやく}→契約：02698_keiyaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{解釈|かいしゃく}→解釈：02603_kaishaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{疑義|ぎぎ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生|しょう}じた→生じる：02118_shoujiru⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{双方|そうほう}→双方：11859_souhou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{協議|きょうぎ}→協議：02635_kyougi⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: If any question arises over the interpretation of the contract, both parties will consult.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {疑義|ぎぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{呈|てい}する→呈する：12003_teisuru⟧: to raise a doubt, to question
- {疑義|ぎぎ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生|しょう}じる→生じる：02118_shoujiru⟧: a question arises
- {疑義|ぎぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{挟|はさ}む→挟む：00091_hasamu⟧: to cast doubt on
- {疑義|ぎぎ}⟦{照会|しょうかい}→照会：16171_shoukai⟧: a pharmacist's query to the prescribing doctor

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{疑問|ぎもん}→疑問：02648_gimon⟧: question, doubt — the everyday word; {疑義|ぎぎ} questions the correctness or legitimacy of something specific and belongs to formal writing
- ⟦{懸念|けねん}→懸念：05622_kenen⟧: concern — worry about what may happen, not doubt about what is right
